instruction:
Purge Orphan Datablocks `/home/user/Desktop/scene.blend` contains a mesh
object `Cube` that uses `Mat_InUse`, which in turn uses `Img_InUse`. Launch Blender by running `blender` from a terminal. At the start of the task, use `/opt/blender/blender` for Blender command-line or background runs when working on `scene.blend`.

The file is cluttered with 12 fake-user materials and 6 fake-user images.
Some orphan materials reference some of the orphan images, so the cleanup
must be done carefully: remove the unused materials and then remove any
now-unreferenced images, without disturbing `Cube`, `Mat_InUse`, or
`Img_InUse`.

## Requirements
1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.blend` opens as a valid Blender file.
2. `Cube` still exists and its first material slot is `Mat_InUse`.
3. `Mat_InUse` exists.
4. `Img_InUse` exists.
5. No `Mat_Orphan_*` material remains.
6. No `Img_Orphan_*` image remains.
7. `len(bpy.data.materials) == 1`.
8. Exactly one user-created image remains.

Do not rename `Cube`, its material, or its image; only purge the orphaned
datablocks.
